extraction_instructions: The action as the transition plan states it: one specific measure, technology or asset. Vague intentions (for example 'we will reduce emissions') are not actions.
Classify the action with exactly one id from the allowed list, or 'other' if none fits.
Whether the action is already implemented (in operation) or planned.
The calendar year the action is (or was) in operation. Leave empty if the plan states no year.
Where the action takes place, if the plan states it.
The quantified greenhouse gas saving the plan links to this action. Give the unit exactly as stated: 'tCO2e/yr', 'MtCO2e/yr' or '%'.
The investment this action needs. Report it in the reporting currency (never convert): give the unit as the ISO 4217 code with the scale word separate, for example 'EUR million'.
The funds allocated or approved for this action. Report it in the reporting currency (never convert): give the unit as the ISO 4217 code with the scale word separate, for example 'EUR million'.
The company owns or operates production sites, plants, fleets or fields in the European Union (Yes or No).
The company owns or operates production sites, plants, fleets or fields in the United States (Yes or No).
The company owns or operates production sites, plants, fleets or fields in China (Yes or No).

A carbon price the plan assumes. Give the unit as '<currency>/tCO2', for example 'EUR/tCO2'. Use basis 'region:<Region>' for the region it applies to, or 'region:any'; report the year it applies to as period_end (31 December), if stated.

A hydrogen cost the plan assumes. Give the unit as '<currency>/kg H2', for example 'EUR/kg H2'. Use basis 'region:<Region>' or 'region:any'; report the year it applies to as period_end (31 December), if stated.
